title: Fetch with Async/Await & HTTP Error Handling
promptSeed: Write an async function fetchData(url) using native fetch. Validate response.ok, parse via await response.json(), throw an Error with the response status if unsuccessful, and handle network rejections in try/catch.

title: Promise Chaining without Async/Await
promptSeed: Write a function getUserData(url) using raw .then(), .catch(), and .finally() chaining. Parse the JSON response, handle errors gracefully, and execute a cleanup log in .finally(). Do not use async/await.

title: Parallel Network Requests (allSettled)
promptSeed: Write an async function fetchAllUsers(urls) that requests data from multiple URLs in parallel using Promise.allSettled. Return an array containing only the fulfilled data payloads, ignoring rejected requests.

title: Request Cancellation via AbortController
promptSeed: Write a function fetchWithTimeout(url, timeoutMs) that uses an AbortController to abort the fetch if it does not settle before timeoutMs. Ensure the timer is cleared if the request resolves first.

title: Debounce Function Implementation
promptSeed: Implement debounce(fn, delay) from scratch. Ensure the returned function preserves the calling 'this' context and passes all forwarded arguments to fn.

title: Throttle Function Implementation
promptSeed: Implement throttle(fn, limit) from scratch in vanilla JavaScript. Ensure that fn is invoked at most once per every limit milliseconds.

title: Event Loop & Task Scheduling Trace
promptSeed: Write a short code example illustrating the execution order of Promise.resolve().then(), setTimeout(..., 0), queueMicrotask(), and synchronous execution, along with a comment stating the exact output sequence.
testHarness:
const order = getExecutionOrder();
console.log('Event loop sequence:', JSON.stringify(order) === '["sync","microtask","macrotask"]' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', order);

title: Frequency Counter via Native Map
promptSeed: Write a function countFrequencies(arr) that uses JavaScript Map (.get, .set, .has) to count item occurrences in O(n) time and returns the Map.

title: Set Operations & Array Deduplication
promptSeed: Write a function arrayIntersection(a, b) that returns the unique common elements between two unsorted arrays in O(n + m) time using a Set.
testHarness:
const r = arrayIntersection([1, 2, 2, 1], [2, 2]);
console.log('Intersection ([2]):', JSON.stringify(r) === '[2]' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Recursive Array Flattening
promptSeed: Write a function flatten(arr) that flattens an arbitrarily nested array of numbers into a single flat array without using Array.prototype.flat.
testHarness:
const res = flatten([1, [2, [3, 4], 5]]);
console.log('Flattened deep array [1,2,3,4,5]:', JSON.stringify(res) === '[1,2,3,4,5]' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Custom Array.prototype.reduce
promptSeed: Implement myReduce(array, callback, initialValue) from scratch. Correctly handle cases where initialValue is provided versus omitted (using the first element as the initial accumulator).
testHarness:
const sum = myReduce([1, 2, 3, 4], (a, b) => a + b, 0);
console.log('Reduce sum (10):', sum === 10 ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Deep Clone of Plain Objects
promptSeed: Write a function deepClone(value) that deep-copies nested objects and arrays without using JSON.parse(JSON.stringify()) or structuredClone().

title: LRU Cache Implementation
promptSeed: Implement an LRUCache class with capacity, get(key), and put(key, value) operations executing in O(1) time complexity.

title: Function Currying
promptSeed: Implement a curry(fn) utility that enables a multi-argument function to be called sequentially until all expected arguments (fn.length) are supplied.

title: useFetch with Abort Cleanup
promptSeed: Implement a custom hook useFetch(url) returning { data, loading, error }. Use an AbortController inside useEffect to cancel the request if the url changes or the component unmounts.
testHarness: console.log('useFetch defined as function:', typeof useFetch === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: useDebounce Hook
promptSeed: Implement a custom hook useDebounce(value, delay) in React that returns the debounced value after delay ms of stability.
testHarness: console.log('useDebounce defined as function:', typeof useDebounce === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Controlled Form Input Handling
promptSeed: Write a controlled SearchForm component that manages input text state, handles onChange, trims whitespace on onSubmit, and calls an onSearch(query) prop.
testHarness: console.log('SearchForm component defined:', typeof SearchForm === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: usePrevious Hook via useRef
promptSeed: Write a custom usePrevious(val) hook using useRef and useEffect that returns the value from the previous render.
testHarness: console.log('usePrevious defined as function:', typeof usePrevious === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Complex State with useReducer
promptSeed: Implement a Todo list state machine using useReducer supporting action types 'ADD_TODO', 'TOGGLE_TODO', and 'REMOVE_TODO'.

title: Infinite Scroll Sentinel with IntersectionObserver
promptSeed: Write a React component or hook that attaches an IntersectionObserver to a bottom sentinel div element and calls onLoadMore() whenever it becomes visible.
testHarness: console.log('useInfiniteScroll defined:', typeof useInfiniteScroll === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: React Context Provider with Custom Hook
promptSeed: Create a ThemeContext provider managing 'light' | 'dark' mode and a useTheme() consumer hook that throws an informative error if called outside the provider.
testHarness: console.log('createThemeContext defined:', typeof createThemeContext === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Two-Pointer Sorted Pair Sum
promptSeed: Write twoSumSorted(numbers, target) returning indices (1-indexed) of two numbers in an already sorted array that add up to target in O(n) time and O(1) space.
testHarness:
console.log('twoSumSorted [2,7,11,15], target 9 -> [1,2]:', JSON.stringify(twoSumSorted([2, 7, 11, 15], 9)) === '[1,2]' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');
console.log('twoSumSorted [2,3,4], target 6 -> [1,3]:', JSON.stringify(twoSumSorted([2, 3, 4], 6)) === '[1,3]' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
promptSeed: Write lengthOfLongestSubstring(s) finding the length of the longest substring with unique characters using a dynamic sliding window in O(n) time.

title: Maximum Sum Subarray of Size K
promptSeed: Write maxSubarraySum(arr, k) calculating the maximum contiguous subarray sum of fixed size k in O(n) time complexity.

title: Valid Parentheses via Stack
promptSeed: Write isValidParentheses(s) that uses a stack to verify if a string of characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[', ']' is strictly valid and closed in proper order.
testHarness:
console.log('"()[]{}" (true):', isValidParentheses("()[]{}") === true ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');
console.log('"(]" (false):', isValidParentheses("(]") === false ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Binary Search Implementation
promptSeed: Implement binarySearch(nums, target) returning the index of target in a sorted ascending array, or -1 if not found, in O(log n) time.

title: Binary Tree Level-Order Traversal
promptSeed: Implement levelOrder(root) using a queue to return an array of arrays representing the node values of a binary tree level by level.

title: Merge Overlapping Intervals
promptSeed: Write mergeIntervals(intervals) that takes an array of interval pairs [[start, end], ...], sorts them, and merges all overlapping intervals in O(n log n) time.
testHarness:
const merged = mergeIntervals([[1,3],[2,6],[8,10],[15,18]]);
console.log('Merged [[1,6],[8,10],[15,18]]:', JSON.stringify(merged) === '[[1,6],[8,10],[15,18]]' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', merged);

title: Debounce with Cancel and Flush
promptSeed: Implement debounce(fn, wait) returning a function that delays invocation until wait ms after the last call, preserving `this` and arguments. Add .cancel() to drop the pending call and .flush() to invoke it immediately.

title: Throttle with Leading/Trailing Options
promptSeed: Implement throttle(fn, wait, {leading, trailing}) so fn runs at most once per wait window. With trailing enabled, the last call made during a window must fire at the window's end with the latest arguments.

title: Memoize with Custom Key Resolver
promptSeed: Implement memoize(fn, resolver?) caching results by resolver(...args), defaulting to the first argument as the key. Cache falsy results correctly (use has(), not truthiness) and preserve `this`.

title: Function.prototype.bind Polyfill
promptSeed: Implement a bind polyfill supporting partial application of arguments. A bound function invoked with `new` must ignore the bound `this` and keep the prototype chain intact.

title: Deep Clone with Cycles
promptSeed: Implement deepClone(value) handling primitives, arrays, plain objects, Date, Map, and Set. Circular references must be preserved via a WeakMap, not cause infinite recursion.

title: Typed Event Emitter
promptSeed: Build an EventEmitter with on, off, once, and emit. Listeners fire in registration order, removing a listener during emit must not skip others, and the TypeScript version types payloads by event name.

title: Curry and Compose/Pipe
promptSeed: Implement curry(fn) that collects arguments across calls until fn.length is satisfied, then invokes fn. Also implement pipe(...fns) and compose(...fns) for left-to-right and right-to-left composition.

title: Promise.all / allSettled / race Polyfills
promptSeed: Implement Promise.all so results preserve input order, non-promise values are accepted, and the first rejection rejects the result. Then adapt it to allSettled and race, handling an empty iterable correctly.
testHarness:
const p = await promiseAll([Promise.resolve(1), 2, Promise.resolve(3)]);
console.log('Promise.all polyfill [1,2,3]:', JSON.stringify(p) === '[1,2,3]' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', p);

title: Concurrency-Limited Promise Pool
promptSeed: Implement pool(tasks, limit) running at most `limit` promise-returning tasks at once and resolving results in input order. Start the next task as soon as any slot frees, and reject on first failure.

title: Retry with Exponential Backoff and Abort
promptSeed: Implement retry(fn, {retries, baseDelay, factor, signal}) retrying a failing async fn with exponentially growing delays. Abort via AbortSignal must stop waiting immediately and reject with the abort reason.

title: Fetch with Timeout and In-Flight Deduplication
promptSeed: Wrap fetch so concurrent calls for the same key share one in-flight promise, and each call aborts after a timeout. The shared entry must be removed on settle so later calls refetch.

title: Sequential Async Task Queue
promptSeed: Build a queue where add(task) returns a promise for that task's result and tasks execute strictly one at a time in FIFO order. A failed task must reject only its own promise and not block the queue.

title: Express-Style Middleware Pipeline
promptSeed: Implement a minimal app.use(fn) and handle(req, res) that runs middleware in order via next(), supporting async handlers and error-handling middleware with (err, req, res, next). Calling next() twice must be guarded against.

title: In-Memory Rate Limiter Middleware
promptSeed: Write a middleware limiting each client key to N requests per window using a token bucket or sliding window. Return 429 with a Retry-After header when exceeded, and evict stale entries to avoid memory leaks.

title: LRU Cache with TTL
promptSeed: Implement an LRU cache with O(1) get and set, a max capacity, and optional per-entry TTL. Accessing an entry refreshes its recency, and expired entries are never returned.

title: Flatten Nested Arrays and Objects
promptSeed: Implement flatten(arr, depth) for nested arrays with an optional depth limit, and flattenObject(obj) producing dot-path keys. Handle empty arrays/objects and avoid mutating the input.

title: groupBy / countBy / keyBy with reduce
promptSeed: Implement groupBy(items, keyFnOrProp) returning buckets of items per key, then derive countBy and keyBy. Preserve insertion order within groups and handle the key function receiving index.

title: Array map / filter / reduce Polyfills
promptSeed: Implement Array.prototype.map, filter, and reduce honoring thisArg and callback signature (value, index, array). Reduce without an initial value on an empty array must throw TypeError, and sparse holes are skipped.
testHarness:
const doubled = [1, 2, 3].myMap(x => x * 2);
console.log('myMap doubled [2,4,6]:', JSON.stringify(doubled) === '[2,4,6]' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Safe get / set by Path
promptSeed: Implement get(obj, 'a.b[0].c', default) and set(obj, path, value). Set creates intermediate arrays for numeric segments and objects otherwise, and get returns default only for undefined results.

title: Deep Equality Comparison
promptSeed: Implement deepEqual(a, b) for primitives, arrays, plain objects, Dates, and NaN. Compare key sets rather than just values and handle cycles or explicitly state the assumption.
testHarness:
console.log('Equal objects match:', deepEqual({ a: [1, 2] }, { a: [1, 2] }) === true ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');
console.log('Unequal objects fail:', deepEqual({ a: 1 }, { a: 2 }) === false ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Immutable Sort, Dedupe, and Merge of Records
promptSeed: Given a list of records, return a new array deduped by id (latest wins) and sorted by multiple keys with stable ordering. Input must not be mutated and a comparator must handle strings, numbers, and nulls.

title: useDebounce and useThrottle Hooks
promptSeed: Write useDebounce(value, delay) returning the value only after it has been stable for delay ms. Clear the timer on change and unmount, and avoid stale closures.
testHarness: console.log('useDebounce defined as function:', typeof useDebounce === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: useFetch with Race-Condition Safety
promptSeed: Build useFetch(url) returning {data, error, loading}, aborting the previous request when url changes or the component unmounts. Never set state from a stale response.
testHarness: console.log('useFetch defined as function:', typeof useFetch === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Typeahead / Autocomplete Component
promptSeed: Build an autocomplete that debounces input, fetches suggestions, ignores out-of-order responses, and supports arrow-key navigation, Enter to select, and Escape to close. Include basic combobox ARIA roles.
testHarness: console.log('Typeahead defined:', typeof Typeahead === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: usePrevious, useLatest, and useInterval
promptSeed: Implement usePrevious(value) and useInterval(callback, delay) that always calls the latest callback without resetting the timer. Passing a null delay pauses the interval.
testHarness: console.log('useLatest & useInterval defined:', typeof useLatest === 'function' && typeof useInterval === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Infinite Scroll with IntersectionObserver
promptSeed: Build a list that loads the next page when a sentinel element enters the viewport. Prevent duplicate page fetches while loading, stop at the last page, and disconnect the observer on cleanup.
testHarness: console.log('InfiniteList defined:', typeof InfiniteList === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Accessible Modal with Portal and Focus Trap
promptSeed: Create a Modal rendered via createPortal that closes on Escape and backdrop click, traps Tab focus inside, and restores focus to the trigger on close. Lock body scroll while open.
testHarness: console.log('Modal component defined:', typeof Modal === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Todo/Form State with useReducer
promptSeed: Build a todo list with add, toggle, edit, delete, and filter using useReducer with a typed action union. Use stable ids as keys and keep derived data (filtered list, counts) computed rather than stored.
testHarness:
const state = todoReducer([{ id: 1, done: false }], { type: 'TOGGLE', id: 1 });
console.log('Reducer toggled done:', state[0].done === true ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Compound Components (Tabs / Accordion)
promptSeed: Implement Tabs, TabList, Tab, and TabPanel sharing state via context, supporting controlled and uncontrolled modes. Add arrow-key roving focus and correct tab/tabpanel ARIA wiring.
testHarness: console.log('Tabs component defined:', typeof Tabs === 'function' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Two Sum and Hash-Map Lookups
promptSeed: Given an array and target, return indices of two numbers summing to target in O(n) with a single pass. State behavior for duplicates, no solution, and reusing the same element.
testHarness:
const res = twoSum([2, 7, 11, 15], 9);
console.log('twoSum hashmap ([0, 1]):', JSON.stringify(res) === '[0,1]' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', res);

title: DOM / Tree Traversal (BFS, DFS, getElementsByClassName)
promptSeed: Implement DFS and BFS over a tree of nodes with children, then use it to build getElementsByClassName or a path-to-node finder. Provide both recursive and iterative versions and discuss stack depth.

title: Merge Intervals and Sliding Window
promptSeed: Merge overlapping intervals after sorting by start, handling touching intervals and unsorted input. Then solve longest substring without repeating characters using a sliding window in O(n).
testHarness:
const r = mergeIntervals([[1,4],[4,5]]);
console.log('Touching intervals merged [[1,5]]:', JSON.stringify(r) === '[[1,5]]' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Discriminated Unions & Exhaustiveness Checking
promptSeed: Define an async state union (Loading, Success<T>, ErrorState). Write a function formatState(state) that exhausts all cases using a switch statement. Enforce compile-time exhaustiveness by assigning the unhandled state to type never in the default branch.
testHarness:
console.log('Success state format:', formatState({ status: 'success', data: { id: 1 } }) === 'Loaded: {"id":1}' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');
console.log('Loading state format:', formatState({ status: 'loading' }) === 'Loading...' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');

title: Generic Fetch Client with Typed Payloads
promptSeed: Write a generic async wrapper apiGet<T>(url: string): Promise<T>. Ensure the returned Promise explicitly resolves to type T and handles non-200 responses with typed error handling.

title: Custom Utility Types (DeepPartial & PickByType)
promptSeed: Implement DeepPartial<T> recursively so all nested object properties become optional, while leaving primitives unchanged. Then implement PickByType<T, ValueType> using mapped and conditional types with key remapping.

title: Generic React Component Props (Generic Select<T>)
promptSeed: Define props and signature for a generic Select component: SelectProps<T> where items is T[], value is T, onChange is (item: T) => void, and getLabel is (item: T) => string. Ensure TypeScript enforces that items and value share the exact same type.

title: Custom User-Defined Type Guards (isRecord, isError)
promptSeed: Write user-defined type guards: isRecord(val: unknown): val is Record<string, unknown> (returns true for non-null plain objects and false for arrays/primitives), and isError(val: unknown): val is Error.

title: Strictly Typed Event Emitter Map
promptSeed: Create a TypedEmitter<Events extends Record<string, any>> where .on<K extends keyof Events>(event: K, listener: (payload: Events[K]) => void) and .emit<K extends keyof Events>(event: K, payload: Events[K]) are strictly type-checked against the event map.
